verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents agent versioning: registering an agent records its instructions, model, and tools so changes can be tracked. It also documents review: comparing a baseline against a candidate version on the same tasks and inspecting the recorded actions behind each score. Rollback appears only as a one-line marketing claim of 'autonomous fix and rollback' for production agents, with no documented workflow. Missing for 10: documented rollback procedure for an agent or automation version, independent or hands-on corroboration of versioning and rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: When you change your agent, register a new version and compare it against the previous one using the same tasks.
This records its instructions, model, and tools so you can track changes between versions.
Compare agent versions on the same tasks and starting state, then inspect the recorded actions behind each score to understand failures.
Real-time monitoring of production agents with autonomous fix and rollback.
